note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. FIXED 2026-09-06: `deriveRecommendation`'s `redirect` recommendation (interpretationBand === 'misuse-risk') used to be unreachable in practice — `scoreAppropriateness` forces `usually-not-appropriate` in the exact same screening-misuse case that `scoreInterpretation` forces `misuse-risk`, and `deriveRecommendation` checked the appropriateness band first, so screening misuse always resolved to query-referrer, never redirect. Fixed by checking `misuse-risk` first in both `js/grader.js` and `src/lib/engine/grader.ts`; the other route to `usually-not-appropriate` (every selected marker mismatched, no screening misuse involved) is unaffected and still resolves to query-referrer. The third persona below (renamed from its old `query-referrer-...` name) now correctly recommends `redirect`. FIXED 2026-09-07: the `reject` recommendation was unreachable because nothing in `deriveRecommendation` ever triggered it. Decided the clinical judgement call this needed (per tasks.md Phase 13's framing): `scoreAppropriateness` returns `appropriatenessScore === 1` on exactly one path -- its early return when zero markers are selected at all (R-APPROP-NO-MARKER-SELECTED) -- distinct from a marker/indication mismatch (score 2 or 5, still query-referrer) and from screening misuse (score 3, still redirect). No marker selected means nothing was actually requested, so there is no marker choice to query or reconsider; the vetting desk rejects the request outright instead. `deriveRecommendation` now takes `appropriatenessScore` as a 4th argument and checks `appropriatenessScore === 1` first, before the generic `usually-not-appropriate` branch that would otherwise intercept it (same shadowing hazard as the redirect fix above -- verified via a scratch script against the real HTML engine, plus 2 new boundary tests proving the screening-misuse and all-mismatched routes still resolve to redirect/query-referrer, not reject). Added the 4th persona below (`no-marker-selected-otherwise-complete-reject`) to demonstrate it; `bin/test-personas --update` 4/4 PASS. Vitest 14/14 passed (up from 12); `pnpm check` clean.

FIXED 2026-09-06: `deriveRecommendation` used to check the generic `usually-not-appropriate` appropriateness band before the `misuse-risk` interpretation band, so `redirect` was unreachable — every screening-misuse case (which always forces both bands together, since interpretationBand's misuse-risk is driven by the exact same screeningMisuse flag as appropriatenessBand) always resolved to the generic `query-referrer` first. Reordered so `misuse-risk` is checked first; this persona now correctly recommends `redirect` rather than `query-referrer`. Several administrative fields are not yet captured — expect usually-not-appropriate + misuse-risk interpretation + routine + redirect, completeness below 100.

personas.name: no-marker-selected-otherwise-complete-reject
personas.description: Fully completed referral in every other respect — clinician, patient, indication, clinical details, and triage all present — but no tumour marker checkbox was ticked at all, so there is nothing for the lab to test. Expect appropriatenessScore 1, usually-not-appropriate, and reject.
